verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is an attorney-led boutique immigration firm handling O-1, EB-1 and other petitions. It sets case strategy, uses paralegals and legal writers, and has an attorney review all work before submission, so the firm clearly prepares and files petitions. However, the evidence never spells out end-to-end preparation of each component the story names. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence-binder assembly, drafting or coordination of expert and support letters, form preparation as a described deliverable, and independent or client corroboration of the full-service scope.
